_comment: Per-troop upgrade progression (WO-771.9 foundation). One row per trainable troop in troops.json. reach/strength are MULTIPLIER curves (values[i] = multiplier at level i+1; baseline 1.0). Reach scales AttackRange + AggroRadius; Strength scales MaxHp + DPS. Early levels give the biggest % gains (deltas shrink) and each troop has ONE main growth track. specialAbilities unlock at level thresholds 3/5/7; abilityId maps to a REAL id in abilities.json (resolve via AbilityCatalog.FindById); statusKind is the DeNelle.BattleATB.Engine.StatusKind the ability applies (Burn/Poison/Bleed/Slow/Freeze/Stun/Regen/Haste/Shield/Mark). DUAL-COPY RULE (BINDING): mirrored byte-identical at Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical/troop-upgrades.json AND Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical/troop-upgrades.json.

upgrades.flavorText: The Footman trades finesse for staying power - every level lands heavier and holds the line longer.

specialAbilities.description: Sweeping Cut - a wide arc that carves the front rank and leaves it bleeding.
Warden's Roar - a battle-cry that quickens nearby allies.
Champion's Combo - a finishing chain that staggers the target.

upgrades.flavorText: The Archer's craft is distance - each level reaches farther and looses faster than the last.

specialAbilities.description: Snare Arrow - a barbed shot that roots the target in place.
Suppressing Volley - a rain of arrows that slows everything beneath it.
Thunderbolt - a crackling shot that stuns on impact.

upgrades.flavorText: The Spearman rules the space in front of the line - reach grows first, power follows.

specialAbilities.description: Sweeping Thrust - a long arc that opens wounds across the clustered front.
Shield Bash - a shoulder-check that staggers the nearest foe.
Warden's Roar - a rallying shout that hastens the spear wall.

upgrades.flavorText: The Field Cleric grows into the formation's sustain anchor - stronger healing and safer reach.

specialAbilities.description: Oathmend - improves restorative cadence.
Eternal Aegis - wards the formation under tower fire.

upgrades.flavorText: The Shieldguard is built to be immovable - nearly all of its growth pours into raw durability.

specialAbilities.description: Shield Bash - slams the choke and stuns whatever it hits.
Eternal Aegis - raises a bulwark that shields the guard and its neighbors.
Warden's Roar - steadies the line and quickens the counter-push.

upgrades.flavorText: The Outrider is a hunter of stragglers - speed and burst climb together to run down towers.

specialAbilities.description: Dash - a burst of speed that closes on a fleeing target.
Sweeping Cut - a mounted slash that bleeds anything it passes.
Champion's Combo - a run-down finisher that staggers the kill.

upgrades.flavorText: The Siege Catapult is a machine of range and ruin - strength climbs, reach stays pinned so it never becomes map artillery.

specialAbilities.description: Impact Shell - a heavy stone that staggers the fortification it strikes.
Shrapnel Volley - a burst that slows anything under the debris.
Incendiary Shot - a burning projectile that sets the target alight.

upgrades.flavorText: The Battlemage answers fragility with overwhelming burst - strength curves hard, reach creeps up.

specialAbilities.description: Emberbrand Throw - a hurled brand that sets the target alight.
Thunderbolt - a bolt of aether that stuns on impact.
Arcane Bolt - a marking cantrip that primes a foe for extra damage.

upgrades.flavorText: The Echo Legionnaire is the Legion's flex elite - a high, balanced climb toward frontline dominance.

specialAbilities.description: Champion's Combo - a legion drill combo that opens deep wounds.
Eternal Aegis - an Echo-forged ward that shields the squad.
Oathmend - a sworn restoration that regenerates the Legionnaire in the fray.
